folds.heading: ### Absorption and restore-evidence uptake B270
folds.body:
Seven complete historical records were read: [audit remainder dispatch](gm/dispatch/AUDIT_REMAINDER_2026_10_06.md), [absorption checkpoint](gm/dispatch/absorb-2026-10-11/CHECKPOINT.md), [mod-fork palette](gm/dispatch/absorb-2026-10-11/MOD_FORK_CONSIDERATIONS.md), [Air proof recipe](gm/dispatch/absorb-all-2026-10-14/air-workshop/README.md), [natural-play evidence](gm/dispatch/absorb-all-2026-10-14/checks/natural-play-2/README.md), [P15 authority proposal](gm/dispatch/absorb-all-2026-10-14/checks/p23-host-joins/P15_SAVE_AUTHORITY_PROPOSAL.md) and [stepper performance qualifications](gm/dispatch/absorb-all-2026-10-14/checks/stepper-perf/README.md). The original bodies, source-local IDs and separate content dispositions remain in B270; their linked reports/scripts/saves/images are not read by proxy.

The October6dispatch is bounded real user implementation authority for that19row queue plus the explicitly added artifact join; it is not a new dispatch now. The absorption checkpoint ends with COMPLETE and release, qualifying its earlier pending phases/worker tables.330tests, combined journey, generated strong-hero/deterministic subpaths, fixed storage/import defects and historical pushes retain their input dates and backlog limits. No current install, remote state or permission to push follows. Current AD36/AD42/AD43 supersedes historical implementation-first/director gates.

Natural-play evidence preserves an important middle ground: actual earned native snapshots/controls and no grants, with advanceTicks and recovery imports, still differ from an uninterrupted real-time natural-pacing run. Two harness timeouts are distinct from paid patrol errors and a training save/display failure. Uninstrumented initial work makes measured timings lower bounds; rolled-back/re-earned work and a separate Undo branch are not twice the retained main-life progress. The screenshot12filename is qualified by the explicit final checkpoint. A recorded native Undo46428→46433→46428 on that build does not prove P15’s separate proposed boot-key atomicity, multicharacter slots or new-key adoption. Validate an actual current selected restore owner before changing authority; no new save key, journal or catch-up is selected here.

The stepper record supports its stated before/after equivalence cases, not an attributable speedup on changing shared load. Inclusive profile samples overlap; canonical comparison excludes saved_at/last_rewarded_export. Retain raw gate FAIL, corrected suite, baseline-identical legacy failure and built-in retries as separate evidence. A prototype benchmark target is not an extra universal release gate. Current target viewports replace1366historical screenshot/reproduction settings for new UI claims. No benchmark or runtime run occurred in this review.

Mod-fork O1–3 preserve useful title collection/readiness/backup ideas, with later title causal roles and actual known-availability projection owners. Small bonus growth and three-snapshot rotation are adjustable proposal values, not power/collection caps. Its old no-code-license finding was not renewed or expanded into legal advice, and no mod code/assets were copied. Hidden-tab advancement needs its actual policy and clock/stock/stop consumers; backup enrollment or a title does not supply offline credit.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B270
folds.body:
Full five-step authority proposal and alternatives reviewed. Keep proposed new-key enrollment, recursive journal stripping, lifetime lock namespace, explicit old-reader policy and single durable write as a design option. The record itself states capture/download is distinct from native gameplay restore. The [natural-play evidence README](../natural-play-2/README.md) separately records native Undo/reload from46428to46433and back on its own build. That is not proof of this proposed key design, atomic quota-failure handling, slots or all legacy compatibility; equally, this older no-native-Undo wording cannot establish today’s absence. The reports and current source/loader/publisher must settle a newly selected claim.

No boot-authority migration is selected by this reconciliation. Q2 was a material compatibility choice for its coordinator at the time, not a standing request to ask the user again now. Current actual authority and the existing save/restore consumer determine any future work. The old1366evidence target and snapshot bound are historical settings; current AD36/AD42/AD43 and relevant UI targets govern new checks. No save, key, journal, command, test or browser result was changed here.
